how_it_runs: Every case carries `attributed_normalized` — the EXACT string the router saw in the audit
(Phase 1 NLP output, entity tokens already protected as «ALIAS»). The test feeds that text
straight into routeIntent(), so routing is asserted WITHOUT the Python NLP bridge and
WITHOUT any ERPNext. Coverage is therefore the ROUTER's decision, not the normalizer's.
